name: Last Threshold
source:
1962. Wiktor Staszewski, the son of a researcher exiled to Siberia, and his mentor set off on an expedition in the footsteps of their long-deceased father. Their task is to explore the mysterious ruins that until now were hidden under a thick layer of ice. It was them that became the cause of Wiktor’s father's obsession.

A team takes part in the expedition, in which each participant has a different approach to the expedition. When a Siberian native joins the team, tensions increase. The conflict within the group increases as the group reach the ruins. Fleeing the storm, they find temporary shelter in them. At least they think so ...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1840770/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1962年，维克托·斯塔泽夫斯基 (Wiktor Staszewski) 是一位被流放到西伯利亚的研究员的儿子，他和他的导师追随已故父亲的脚步踏上了探险之旅。他们的任务是探索迄今为止隐藏在厚厚冰层下的神秘遗迹。正是它们成为了维克托父亲痴迷的原因。

一个团队参加这次探险，每个参与者都有不同的探险方法。当西伯利亚人加入团队时，紧张气氛就会加剧。随着队伍到达废墟，队伍内部的冲突加剧。为了躲避风暴，他们在里面找到了暂时的庇护所。至少他们是这么认为的……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1840770/]Steam[/url]]
